subsections.heading: 24. 环境\kou-sou-shal\e\3责
paragraphs: \e-项目\ha环境\e\3大\e\3im-pak-te\e\3有\wou\3im-pak-te\e\3e-va-liu-ei-shon\ou受\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-其\wou\3缓解\kou监测\e\3措施\ou必要\te行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-sai-ens\kou-tek-no-lo-ji\e\3发展\wou\3人\e\3dig-ni-ti\kou个人\e\3pu-rai-va-si\kou-ko-miu-ni-ti\e\3正当\e\3rait\e\3无由\e\3侵\ou方法\te\hou用\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 25. sai-ens\e\3pou-le-cei\e\3e-va-liu-ei-shon\kou持续\e\3改
paragraphs: \e-e-va-liu-ei-shon\wou\3ri-ser-chi\e\3kuo-li-ti\kou发现\ha有义\kou-o-por-tiu-ni-ti\e\3可及\kou-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3诚信\kou-tek-no-lo-ji\e\3发展\kou-fai-nans\e\3持续性\kou-pab-lik\e\3wel-feir\e\3贡献\ou虑\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-论文\e\3数\kou引用\e\3ran-ke\kou专利\e\3注册\kou商业\e\3收入\kou-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3re-piu-tei-shon\wou\3相关\e\3in-for-mei-shon\ou予\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-此\e\3指标\wou\3实质\e\3sai-ens\kou-sou-shal\e\3e-va-liu-ei-shon\ou代\bou\3\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\wou\3国\e\3sai-ens\e\3sis-tem\e\3ri-viu\ha-in-di-pen-den-te\ou定期\te行\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-其\wou\3适当\e\3结论\kou建议\ou发\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-重大\e\3sis-tem\e\3失灵\kou新\e\3ris-ke\kou-sai-ens\e\3知\e\3大\e\3变\wou\3提早\e\3ri-viu\e\3理由\ou成\e\a\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-pou-le-cei\e\3修\wou\3sai-ens\e\3fu-ri-dom\kou既定\e\3合法\e\3rait\kou正当\e\3pab-lik\e\3约\ou尊\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-其\wou\3pou-le-cei\e\3成效\ou增\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

subsections.heading: 26. lou\e\3性质\kou执行
paragraphs: pou-le-cei\wou\3所述\e\3in-si-ti-tiu-shon\kou-fan-ding\e\3rait\kou-taks\e\3优惠\kou-pab-lik\e\3服务\kou监管\e\3机制\ha已立法\kou已建\e\3宣\pou\2\chi\4\wu\2\le\4。
\e-执行\wou\3适当\e\3立法\kou合法\e\3pab-lik\e\3拨款\kou行政\e\3pu-lan\kou专业\e\3si-tan-dad\kou-in-di-pen-den-te\e\3监督\ou需\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-相关\e\3lou\kou-pou-le-cei\e\3pu-rou-si-jer\wou\3具体\e\3资金\e\3比\kou法定\e\3时限\kou-in-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3pu-rou-si-jer\kou-tek-no-lo-ji\e\3要求\ou定\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。
\e-执行\wou\3kon-si-ti-tiu-shon\e\3义务\kou基础\e\3rait\kou既定\e\3lou\e\3护\ou适用\te从\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

\e-sen-zou-vi-a\e\3ga-van-man\wou\3此\e\3fu-reim-wer-ke\ou按需\te审\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal。\e-其\wou\3sai-ens\e\3fu-ri-dom\kou-i-no-vei-shon\ha负责\kou-pab-lik\e\3a-kaun-ta-bi-li-ti\kou长期\e\3持续性\e\3互助\ou护\sou\ou\wu\hou\2\wou\3pu-rou-pou-zal\pou\2\chi\4。

closing: sen-zou-vi-a\wou\3sou-shal\ha-sai-ens\e\3好奇\e\3护\kou知\e\3不需\e\3障碍\e\3除\kou-i-no-vei-shon\ha-fu-ri-dom\kou责任\e\3内\e\3发展\kou发现\e\3ri-zal-te\e\3未来\ha有a-bi-li-ti\kou公正\kou繁荣\e\3助\ou此\e\3pou-le-cei\ga建\pou\2\chi\4。
